<template>
  <v-card
    class="mx-auto"
    max-width="448"
  >
    <v-layout>
      <v-app-bar
    color="white"
    >
      <template v-slot:prepend>
        <v-img src="@/assets/logo.png" :width="200" class="custom-v-img"></v-img>
      </template>
  
      <v-spacer></v-spacer>
  
      <v-btn icon @click="value = !value">
        <v-icon>mdi-account</v-icon>
      </v-btn>
      <v-btn v-show="value" @click="logout">
        Sair
      </v-btn>
    </v-app-bar>

      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
          <v-row dense>
            <v-col
              v-for="n in 8"
              :key="n"
              cols="3"
            >
              <v-sheet
                color="grey-lighten-2"
                height="96"
              ></v-sheet>
            </v-col>
          </v-row>
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </v-layout>
  </v-card>

<v-container>
  <v-card class="mx-auto my-10" color="grey-lighten-3">
    
  </v-card>
  
   <v-row justify="center" >
    <v-col cols="6">
      <v-card-title class="text--primary custom-title">Olá João,</v-card-title>
      <v-card-subtitle class="custom-subtitle">Seja bem vindo a sua conta de hospendagem.</v-card-subtitle>

      <v-card class="custom-v-card-iframe mt-9">
        <iframe class="custom-iframe" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/fpa2W3YNg0Q" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen>

        </iframe>
      </v-card>
    </v-col>
   </v-row>
</v-container>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>

<style>
.custom-title {
  font-size: 29px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.custom-subtitle {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: black !important;
}

.custom-v-card-iframe {
  height: 60vh;
}

.custom-iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
</style>
